text_en: When evening came, his slaves quickly withdrew. Bagoas closed the tent from outside and shut out the attendants from his master’s presence. They went to bed, for they all were weary because the banquet had lasted so long.
text_cn: 夜已深了，他的仆役都迅速离去，巴哥阿从外面把帐幕关好，又示意叫侍从离开主人面前；由于宴饮时间过长，人都感到疲乏，就各自上床睡了。

text_en: But Judith was left alone in the tent, with Holofernes stretched out on his bed, for he was dead drunk.
text_cn: 此时，在帐幕内只有友弟德，和泥醉横卧在床上的敖罗斐乃。

text_en: Now Judith had told her maid to stand outside the bedchamber and to wait for her to come out, as she did on the other days; for she said she would be going out for her prayers. She had said the same thing to Bagoas.
text_cn: 友弟德遂吩咐自己的婢女，要她像平日一样，在寝室外等候她出来，因为她说自己要出去祈祷；且也对巴哥阿这样说了。

text_en: So everyone went out, and no one, either small or great, was left in the bedchamber. Then Judith, standing beside his bed, said in her heart, “O Lord God of all might, look in this hour on the work of my hands for the exaltation of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 此时，所有的人都走了，不论大小，没有一个留在寝室内。友弟德就站在他的床边，心里说：“上主，全能的天主！求你在此时，眷顾我手要行的工作，为显扬耶路撒冷！

text_en: Now indeed is the time to help your heritage and to carry out my design to destroy the enemies who have risen up against us. ”
text_cn: 因为如今正是救助你家业的时候，请玉成我的计划，消灭那起来攻击我们的敌人！”

text_en: She went up to the bedpost near Holofernes’ head, and took down his sword that hung there.
text_cn: 她走到靠敖罗斐乃头部的床柱前，由上面取下了他的短剑，

text_en: She came close to his bed, took hold of the hair of his head, and said, “Give me strength today, O Lord God of Israel! ”
text_cn: 再走近床前，抓住他的头发说：“上主，以色列的天主，求你今天赐我力量！”

text_en: Then she struck his neck twice with all her might, and cut off his head.
text_cn: 遂用尽气力，在他颈上砍了两下，割下他的头颅，

text_en: Next she rolled his body off the bed and pulled down the canopy from the posts. Soon afterward she went out and gave Holofernes’ head to her maid,
text_cn: 把他的尸首从床上滚下，由柱上卸下帐幔，即刻走出，将敖罗斐乃的头，交给自己的使女；

text_en: who placed it in her food bag. Then the two of them went out together, as they were accustomed to do for prayer. They passed through the camp, circled around the valley, and went up the mountain to Bethulia, and came to its gates.
text_cn: 使女把头放进食袋里。然后二人一起，照习惯出外祈祷去了。二人经过兵营，绕过山谷，爬上拜突里雅山，来到了自己的城门下。

text_en: From a distance Judith called out to the sentries at the gates, “Open, open the gate! God, our God, is with us, still showing his power in Israel and his strength against our enemies, as he has done today! ”
text_cn: 友弟德从远处向守门的人说：“开门！开门啊！天主，我们的天主，与我们同在，他今日所作的，再次证明他在以色列中的能力，和处置敌人的威力。”

text_en: When the people of her town heard her voice, they hurried down to the town gate and summoned the elders of the town.
text_cn: 城里的人，一听见她的声音，就赶快下来，到城门口，召集了城中的长老。

text_en: They all ran together, both small and great, for it seemed unbelievable that she had returned. They opened the gate and welcomed them. Then they lit a fire to give light, and gathered around them.
text_cn: 于是老幼大小一齐都跑来，由于她回来实在出乎他们意料之外。遂开门迎接她们，点起明亮的火把，将二人围起来。

text_en: Then she said to them with a loud voice, “Praise God, O praise him! Praise God, who has not withdrawn his mercy from the house of Israel, but has destroyed our enemies by my hand this very night! ”
text_cn: 友弟德大声对他们说：“赞美天主！赞美，赞美天主！他不但没有从以色列家收回他的仁慈，今夜反藉着我的手，粉碎了我们的敌人。”

text_en: Then she pulled the head out of the bag and showed it to them, and said, “See here, the head of Holofernes, the commander of the Assyrian army, and here is the canopy beneath which he lay in his drunken stupor. The Lord has struck him down by the hand of a woman.
text_cn: 遂由袋里取出一个人头来，指着对他们说：“看，这就是亚述军队的总司令敖罗斐乃的头。看！这就是他醉后睡的帐幔！上主藉着一个妇人的手，击杀了他。

text_en: As the Lord lives, who has protected me in the way I went, I swear that it was my face that seduced him to his destruction, and that he committed no sin with me, to defile and shame me. ”
text_cn: 上主永在！他在我行的路上保护了我，因为我的容貌迷惑了他，叫他趋于丧亡；他未曾与我犯罪，玷污羞辱我。”

text_en: All the people were greatly astonished. They bowed down and worshiped God, and said with one accord, “Blessed are you our God, who have this day humiliated the enemies of your people. ”
text_cn: 民众听了，不胜惊奇，都俯伏在地，朝拜天主，同声说道：“今日使你民族的敌人化为乌有的，我们的天主啊！你是应受赞美的！”

text_en: Then Uzziah said to her, “O daughter, you are blessed by the Most High God above all other women on earth; and blessed be the Lord God, who created the heavens and the earth, who has guided you to cut off the head of the leader of our enemies.
text_cn: 敖齐雅对她说：“我女！全世界妇女中，你分外应受至高者天主的祝福！创造天地的上主，领你割取我们的敌人统帅头颅的天主，应受赞美！

text_en: Your praise will never depart from the hearts of those who remember the power of God.
text_cn: 在永远记得天主能力的人心中，不会忘记你的信心。

text_en: May God grant this to be a perpetual honor to you, and may he reward you with blessings, because you risked your own life when our nation was brought low, and you averted our ruin, walking in the straight path before our God. ” And all the people said, “Amen. Amen. ”
text_cn: 你不忍见我们民族所受的屈辱，竟不顾惜你的性命，出去挽救我们的危亡，在我们的天主面前，履行正道；希望天主永远使你获得光荣，赐与你幸福！”民众答说：“但愿如此！但愿如此！”
